values = [1, 2, 3, 4]
squares = [x**2 for x in values if x % 2 == 0]
assert squares == [4, 16]

import numpy as np
a = np.array([[1., 2.], [3., 4.]])
means = a.mean(axis=0)
weights = np.array([10., 100.])
scaled = a * weights[:, None]
assert np.allclose(means, [2., 3.])
assert np.allclose(scaled, [[10., 20.], [300., 400.]])
alternatives:
import numpy as np
a = np.array([[1., 2.], [3., 4.]])
means = a.mean(axis = 0)
weights = np.array([10., 100.])
scaled = a * weights[:, None]
assert np.allclose(means, [2., 3.])
assert np.allclose(scaled, [[10., 20.], [300., 400.]])

import numpy as np
a = np.array([[1., 2.], [3., 4.]])
means = a.mean(axis=0)
weights = np.array([10., 100.])
scaled = a * weights[:, np.newaxis]
assert np.allclose(means, [2., 3.])
assert np.allclose(scaled, [[10., 20.], [300., 400.]])

import re
pattern = r"[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{3}"
assert re.fullmatch(pattern, "AB-123") is not None
assert re.fullmatch(pattern, "AB-1234") is None
alternatives:
import re
pattern = r"[A-Z]{2}-\d{3}"
assert re.fullmatch(pattern, "AB-123") is not None
assert re.fullmatch(pattern, "AB-1234") is None
